SWISSIMAGE / swisstopo, imagery year 2024. Extracted from the application's
georeferenced capture of Bleichemattstrasse 31, 5000 Aarau, on 11 September 2026.
Selection: 47.390547, 8.054623. Resolution: 10 cm/pixel.

The fixture is a 170 x 130 pixel crop containing two visually reviewed fan banks.
It is a regression example, not a held-out obstacle accuracy benchmark and is
not used to train the neural networks. The detection is a repeated-circle image
heuristic; it does not assign an exhaust, smoke-vent or equipment subtype.
